name: mirage
text: Thanks for the screenshot. The list is longer than the screen, so scroll down on that APIs tab. Cards are sorted by state, so SharpAPI sits further down. If you scroll to the bottom and it still isn't there, you're on an app older than v1.0.42 and need to install v1.0.43 (link in my last message). Tell me which it is and I'll fix whichever applies. On the engine side SharpAPI is healthy either way.
